title: A Ember for the Wolf Revisited
author: Q. M. Pemberton
blurb: Rafael Fairweather, a cartographer of unmapped realms, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. Then a child arrives at the door speaking a language that predates kingdoms — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must steal back a soul sold to the court beneath the mountain before the usurper's armies reach the free cities.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
